notes: The overdue slip keeps its original due date (Oct 9, 2026); Today computes 'overdue' from due_at at read time. A model that rolls 'Oct 9' forward to 2027 fails date accuracy. The concert sentence must produce no item.

items.title: Return Leo's field trip permission slip
items.quote: Leo's field trip permission slip, which was due Oct 9, has not been returned yet.
items.note: D28: 12 days back, within the 30-day window, so this year: overdue. Could be typed request; type is informational.

items.title: Decide whether Leo gets a photo retake
items.quote: If you would like Leo to have his photo retaken, please return the order form by Oct 30.
items.note: The 'if' is the parent's choice, not a hedge on the deadline: a decision with an explicit date. Due date is the order deadline (Oct 30), not retake day (Nov 4).
